# Harmonic alignment notes

The v1.1 pump event is built as a complementary pair, not a dominant layer plus
background decoration.

```text
chuecka pump gesture  -> bright "chic" / upper mechanical harmonic
                         |  3–4 ms around the main impact anchors
                         v
gpump cycle            -> heavy "chuk" / low-mid mechanical mass
```

Alignment is derived from `gpump89_params.cycle_ms`, so a heavy slow pump and a
faster shell-ejecting pump each receive their own timing scale.

`gss89_mix.pump_chuecka_delay_ms` remains available as a host-side fine trim.
The v1.1 default is 24 ms after automatic retiming.
